title: Add scratch-only Python ASS subtitle stage
summary: Enable one Python-backed subtitle-convert path for a standalone scratch ASS/SSA artifact while leaving integrated subtitle and media policy in PowerShell.
reason: After scratch-only rename, standalone ASS/SSA-to-SRT is the lowest-risk remaining stage slice because the repository already has a tested Python parser/filter/renderer and the dispatcher can exclude container streams, OCR, source media, and publish behavior.
behavior_before: subtitle-convert was a descriptive disabled stage contract; PowerShell owned all production subtitle work.
behavior_after: The Python dispatcher may parse one standalone .ass/.ssa file under a trusted scratch root and create one non-overwriting sibling .srt. Execute requires confirm_subtitle_convert=true, UUID operation identity, a matching content-bound dry-run fingerprint, trusted source/scratch roots, command and operation journals, input/output hashes, duplicate replay protection, and scratch-local recovery evidence. No-dialogue or unsafe decode results route to review without output. TX3G, BDPGS/OCR, embedded streams, language routing, container mutation, publish integration, and production subtitle policy remain PowerShell-owned and disabled in this dispatcher path.
tests_added: tests.python.core.subtitles.test_stage_subtitle_convert: dry-run, strict confirmation, boundaries, execute output, journals, duplicate replay, review routing, no-overwrite, stale fingerprint, and rollback
manual_validation: PASS: bundled Python stage contract/runner/PowerShell-entrypoint suite including subtitle executor (67 tests)
PASS: pytest existing ASS helper regression plus new subtitle stage tests (15 tests)
PASS: Invoke-ContractSchemaChecks.ps1, Invoke-PathBoundaryGuardChecks.ps1, Invoke-SrtValidationChecks.ps1, and Invoke-SubtitleBuilderDecisionChecks.ps1
PARTIAL: every generated summary owned by this packet was refreshed; global summary check reports unrelated concurrent stale files
NOT RUN: representative embedded ASS/TX3G/BDPGS real-media validation because this slice is limited to temporary standalone ASS/SSA scratch artifacts and does not authorize production parity
NOT RUN: full release self-test because repeated attempts earlier in this session caused the execution host to close stdout before returning a result; focused gates were used instead
rollback_plan: Set subtitle-convert execution_backend back to disabled, remove run_subtitle_convert_stage and src/mediapipeline/core/subtitles/stage.py, restore the descriptive SubtitleConvertPayload/Result contract, regenerate the stage schema and pipeline map, and rerun the focused stage/subtitle/path-boundary validation. Existing PowerShell production subtitle behavior requires no rollback because it is unchanged.
notes:
Python impact: additive dispatcher executor over existing ASS parsing/rendering helpers and a narrowed stage DTO. No Local API route, WebView control, PowerShell production entrypoint, FFmpeg extraction, OCR, source media, container, output placement, pending publish, or final-library behavior is added. Validation uses temporary representative ASS text only; production embedded subtitle parity and real-media validation remain separately gated. The worktree also contains concurrent AV1, Tauri/WebView, Local API, promotion, and application-facade work owned by other packets; it was not absorbed here.
Clarify dispatcher and PowerShell compatibility stage-name ownership.
